description: REEA-314: build gates lint+test and stamps /__commit.txt (REEA-243 parity) on every Vercel build. Cron = hourly /api/health funnel check; on Hobby the tick lands once/day and the hourly cadence comes from the guarded GitHub-hosted smoke job, so monitoring never depends on paid plans.
buildCommand: echo "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}" > public/__commit.txt && npm run lint && npm run test && next build
